user.title: Connect to Hisho
user.description: Hisho Core's address, as this Home Assistant reaches it (for example {example_url}). Submit, then approve the request in Hisho: it shows in Needs you and on your phone.

data.token: Token (only one made with the command line)

data_description.url: Where Hisho Core answers. Over Tailscale, its https ts.net name.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a Core with a self-signed certificate.
data_description.token: Leave empty: Hisho gives this Home Assistant its own token when you approve it. Only for a read-only token from `hisho home-assistant token`.

reauth_confirm.title: Approve Home Assistant in Hisho again
reauth_confirm.description: Hisho at {url} no longer accepts this Home Assistant (it was revoked, or Hisho was reset). Submit to ask again, then approve it in Hisho.

reconfigure.title: Hisho moved
reconfigure.description: Hisho Core's new address (for example {example_url}). Submit, then approve the request in Hisho.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a Core with a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_auth: Hisho refused the token. Make one with `hisho home-assistant token` on the Core machine.
error.not_hisho: Something answered at that address, but not Hisho Core (or a Hisho too old for Home Assistant pairing).
error.unsupported_schema: This Hisho sends data version {schema}, newer than this integration understands. Update the integration in HACS.
error.pair_busy: Hisho is not taking a new request right now: {error}

abort.wrong_hisho: That address is a different Hisho than the one this entry belongs to. Add it as a new integration instead.
abort.pair_denied: The request was denied in Hisho.
abort.pair_expired: Nobody approved the request in time. Add the integration again and approve it in Hisho within ten minutes.

unsupported_schema.message: Hisho sends data version {schema}, newer than this integration understands. Update the integration.

action_not_allowed.message: Hisho does not let this Home Assistant {action}. The owner can allow it under Home Assistant on Hisho's Add-ons page. ({error})

action_needs_confirm.message: {action} needs a confirmation first: use a card that asks, or pass confirm: true.

no_entry.message: No Hisho is set up and loaded.

which_entry.message: More than one Hisho is set up: say which with config_entry_id.

alert_gone.message: That item is no longer in Hisho's needs-you list (it resolved).

task_gone.message: That task is no longer in Today.md (it moved to Done recently, or was edited).

task_rename.message: Rename a task in Today.md itself; here you can add and tick tasks.

run_action.name: Run a Hisho action
run_action.description: Press any of Hisho's controls. The ones Hisho allows this Home Assistant are listed on the hub's "Actions allowed" sensor.

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

target.name: Target
target.description: What it acts on: a machine, an alert id, an add-on name.

confirm.name: Confirmed
confirm.description: Required for actions that power something off or remove something: ask first.

alert.name: Answer a needs-you item
alert.description: Acknowledge, un-acknowledge, snooze, re-notify or investigate one of Hisho's needs-you items.

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

alert_id.name: Alert
alert_id.description: The item's id (in the Needs you to-do list and the Alert event).

verb.name: What to do
verb.description: Acknowledge, un-acknowledge, snooze, send to the phone again, or have Claude investigate.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Start or end maintenance for the fleet, a machine, a box or an add-on (addon:NAME).

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

target.name: Target
target.description: fleet, a machine, a box, or addon:NAME.

keep_vms.name: Keep its VM running
keep_vms.description: For one fleet machine: do not shut its VM down.

park.name: Park
park.description: Also power off what can be parked.

job.name: Control a job
job.description: Cancel, retry, clear, dispatch or resume one of Hisho's jobs.

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

verb.name: What to do
verb.description: Cancel, retry, clear, dispatch or resume.

create_job.name: Create a job
create_job.description: Queue a new Hisho job (for example a transcription).

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

worker.name: Worker
worker.description: A machine to run it on; empty = Hisho picks.

ask.name: Ask Hisho
ask.description: Ask Hisho something and get its answer back (for scripts and automations). Same assistant as the Hisho Assist agent.

config_entry_id.name: Hisho
config_entry_id.description: Which Hisho, when more than one is set up.

text.name: Question
text.description: What to ask. Saying "think about it", "think hard" or "think really hard" picks a bigger model.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: Pass the same id to follow up.

data_description.show_network: Switches, access points and cameras Hisho's add-ons see (UniFi...). Off by default: Home Assistant's own integrations usually show them already.
